nuggets.text: The Chanticleers play on teal artificial turf at Brooks Stadium, a surface installed in 2015.
Before Brooks Stadium was built, its empty lot was covered in wild watermelons that crews had to work around.
The Chanticleer nickname comes from the proud rooster in Chaucer's The Canterbury Tales.
Coach Ryan Beard is married to a daughter of Bobby Petrino, whom Beard succeeded as Missouri State head coach in 2023.
Chanticleers offensive coordinator Nick Petrino, son of coach Bobby Petrino, was a walk-on quarterback at Arkansas.
Redshirt freshman Deuce Bailey threw three touchdown passes as the Chanticleers rallied from 24-0 down at West Virginia.
Former Chanticleers coach Joe Moglia is a Fordham alum, and the Rams' home stadium is named for him.
Before coaching the Chanticleers, Joe Moglia spent seven years as CEO of TD Ameritrade.
Coach Ryan Beard was twice named All-Sun Belt as a defensive back at Western Kentucky.
The Chanticleers and Fordham meet on the football field for the first time ever on Saturday.
